rationale: Shant brings freight-tech and fraud-prevention expertise from founding Fenderr Freight, while Daniel is actively building Python-based computer vision and real-time processing systems as a robotics student in Los Angeles. Daniel's technical foundation in pose estimation and gesture control could complement Shant's logistics platform work, and both are based in LA with potential to explore how automation and vision systems might address carrier verification challenges.
intro_message: Shant Lokmanian, meet Daniel Wu — a robotics student building computer vision and Python systems who might be valuable to explore how real-time perception tech could enhance freight identity verification.
